title: 贝 money (贝字旁)
intro: 贝 means shell. Cowrie shells were used as money in ancient China, so 贝 marks money, value, buying, prizes and wealth. It is four strokes, and it sits on the left (购, 账) or at the bottom (贵, 费).

ex.zh: 太贵了，能便宜一点儿吗？
ex.p: tài guì le néng pián yi yī diǎnr ma
ex.en: That's too expensive, can you go a bit lower?

ex.p: duō shǎo qián tài guì le
ex.en: How much is it? Too expensive.

ex.p: běi jīng de dōng xī bǐ jiào guì
ex.en: Things in Beijing are fairly expensive.

ex.zh: 她是这家商店的售货员。
ex.p: tā shì zhè jiā shāng diàn de shòu huò yuán
ex.en: She's a salesclerk at this shop.

ex.p: xiàn zài hěn duō rén xǐ huan wǎng gòu
ex.en: Lots of people like shopping online now.

ex.p: zhōu mò wǒ men qù gòu wù ba
ex.en: Let's go shopping this weekend.

ex.p: zhè gè bó wù guǎn shì miǎn fèi de
ex.en: This museum is free.

ex.p: shì miǎn fèi de ma
ex.en: Is it free?

ex.p: fú wù yuán jié zhàng
ex.en: Waiter, the bill please!

ex.zh: 你的账户里还有多少钱？
ex.p: nǐ de zhàng hù lǐ hái yǒu duō shǎo qián
ex.en: How much money is left in your account?

ex.zh: 我在手机上贴了一张贴纸。
ex.p: wǒ zài shǒu jī shǎng tiē le yī zhāng tiē zhǐ
ex.en: I stuck a sticker on my phone.

ex.zh: 他的工资不高，可是工作很有意思。
ex.p: tā de gōng zī bù gāo kě shì gōng zuò hěn yǒu yì si
ex.en: His pay isn't high, but the work is interesting.

ex.p: wǒ xiǎng zhuàn gēng duō de qián
ex.en: I want to earn more money.

ex.p: tā yī gè yuè néng zhuàn yī mò kuài
ex.en: He can earn ten thousand yuan a month.

ex.p: zuó tiān de bǐ sài wǒ men yíng le
ex.en: We won yesterday's match.

ex.zh: 你看了昨天的足球比赛吗？
ex.p: nǐ kàn le zuó tiān de zú qiú bǐ sài ma
ex.en: Did you watch yesterday's soccer match?

ex.p: fú wù yuán jié zhàng
ex.en: Waiter, the bill please!

ex.zh: 她是这家商店的售货员。
ex.p: tā shì zhè jiā shāng diàn de shòu huò yuán
ex.en: She's a salesclerk at this shop.

ex.p: zhè shì gōng sī de xīn yuán gōng
ex.en: This is the company's new employee.

ex.p: shī bài shì chéng gōng zhī mǔ
ex.en: Failure is the mother of success.

ex.p: zhè cì shī bài le xià cì zài lái
ex.en: Failed this time, try again next time.

ex.p: xīn nián kuài lè gōng xǐ fā cái
ex.en: Happy New Year, and may you prosper!

texts.title: 读一读 · 贝 money (贝字旁)

lines.zh: 小王是一家商店的售货员，工资不高，可是他很喜欢这份工作。
lines.p: xiǎo wáng shì yī jiā shāng diàn de shòu huò yuán gōng zī bù gāo kě shì tā hěn xǐ huan zhè fèn gōng zuò

lines.zh: 周末很多人来购物，商店里很忙。
lines.p: zhōu mò hěn duō rén lái gòu wù shāng diàn lǐ hěn máng

lines.zh: 有一个客人说：“这件衣服太贵了，能便宜一点儿吗？”
lines.p: yǒu yī gè kè rén shuō zhè jiàn yī fu tài guì le néng pián yi yī diǎnr ma

lines.zh: 小王说：“今天买一件，送一张贴纸，是免费的！”
lines.p: xiǎo wáng shuō jīn tiān mǎi yī jiàn sòng yī zhāng tiē zhǐ shì miǎn fèi de
kè rén hěn gāo xìng mǎi le liǎng jiàn
